summary: Stockmen's lookout on Crane Ridge in Alameda County, built 1914 or about 1916 and last staffed in 1973; only the foundation remains, on private ranch land.

facts.status_note: Only the foundation remains. The register lists the site as on a private ranch.

access.note: The register lists the site as on a private ranch.

facts.agency: The Stockmen's Protective Association of Livermore

events.note: Register gives 1914 with volunteer labor; East Bay Times says the association financed it around 1916
Fire came within half a mile of the station in July 1927; Mrs. Mendenhall stayed at her post
Grass fire threatened the station in July 1933; the county fire patrol is credited with saving it
New tower room under way in May 1941 for better visibility; the East Bay Times describes a second-story room added later, undated
Mrs. Henrietta Mendenhall returned to duty at the lookout (May 1942 clipping)
One ranch family member's recollection in the East Bay Times; the register dates the end of service to 1973
Gus Theil was the last to serve there

corrections.why: The register says only the foundation remains. 'ruins' (footings or remains only) fits that better than 'gone'.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the structure was removed at an unknown date; the East Bay Times says vandals burned it in the 1970s. Both agree that only the foundation remains.
The register's 1973 end of service is the documented date. The 1969 closing is one family member's recollection in the East Bay Times and is recorded as an event only with that caveat.

notes_for_editor: Build year: register 1914 vs East Bay Times around 1916; both kept. Staffing span: EBT says the Mendenhall family held the job 1926-1940, but a May 1942 clipping shows Henrietta back on duty; the register says 1942. End of service: register 1973 vs a family recollection of 1969. Demise: register says removed (date unknown, before 1986); EBT says vandals burned it in the 1970s; no date given for either. Location conflict in the record (FFLOS 37.606031, -121.620286 vs west_us_lookouts 37.60083, -121.61639) is about 0.7 km apart and was not resolved. Elevation: register gives 2,962 ft (903 m); EBT gives 2,675 ft for the ridge; the record's 902.8 m was left alone. Name variants: the register uses both 'Cattlemen's' and 'Stockmen's' Protective Association; the EBT and clippings use 'Stockmens'. The story treats them as naming variants of the same Livermore group, which the sources do not state outright. The register photo is already in the record; no new photos. Current ownership and public access are not documented beyond the register's 'Private Ranch' label. The Livermore Heritage Guild PDF in the search results did not fetch.
